verdict.rationale: Plausible documents a read-only Stats API whose /api/v2/query endpoint accepts simple and complex stats queries and returns metrics as JSON, with team-scoped API keys, so the analytical-query half of the story is covered. Nothing in the evidence shows raw event-level data being retrievable through an API: the Stats API returns aggregated metrics, and 'Export stats: download your data' is a download feature, not a documented export API. Missing for 10: documented raw event-level export via API, details of the export format and scope, a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run analytical queries and pull raw event data back through a documented query/export API

citations.quote: Plausible Stats API is a read-only HTTP interface for viewing historical and real-time stats.
The /api/v2/query endpoint accepts simple and complex stats queries in the POST request body and returns the metrics as JSON.
API keys are scoped to one team.
